BiblicalUsage: God tells Jonah to go to Nineveh and preach the preaching he is bid. The word is the proclamation itself — the message carried, not the messenger.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the preaching God bids is enough, because Jonah's message was short and a whole city repented.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
